localizedValues.name: S1-Fossil Bay
localizedValues.description: The Fossil Bay Day Use Shelter is located at the head of Dock 2 in Fossil Bay. The park is only reachable by tour boat or private boat. The site includes the shelter with 4 picnic tables, a large fire ring with 6 tables and 3 barbecues. Composting toilets and water are nearby. Moorage is available first come first serve payable upon arrival.

localizedValues.name: G1-Fox Fossil
localizedValues.description: The Fox Fossil Group Camp is located in between Fossil Bay and Fox Cove, a short walk from the dock. The park is only reachable by tour boat or private boat. The site includes an Adirondack shelter which sleeps 4, a small log shelter with built in table, campsites 6-8 for groups up to 25 people and campsites 4-8 for groups with 26-40 people. Composting toilets and water are nearby. Moorage is available first come first serve payable upon arrival.

localizedValues.name: G3-North Echo
localizedValues.description: The North Echo Group Camp is located on the north end of Echo Bay above the stairs approximately 1.5 mile from the docks. The park is only reachable by tour boat or private boat. There is a small beach at the stairs to land beachable watercraft. The site includes a log shelter with 4 picnic tables, a large fire ring and barbecue. Composting toilets and water are nearby. Moorage is available first come first serve payable upon arrival.

localizedValues.name: G4-Echo Shallow
localizedValues.description: The Echo Shallow Group Camp is located on the isthmus between Echo Bay and Shallow Bay approximately 1 mile from the docks. The park is only reachable by tour boat or private boat. There are small beaches on both Echo Bay and Shallow Bays to land beachable watercraft. The site includes a log shelter with 4 picnic table, campsites 31-34 for groups up to 25 people and campsites 31-36 for groups with 26-48 people. Composting toilets are nearby. Moorage is available first come first serve payable upon arrival.

localizedValues.name: G2-North Shallow
localizedValues.description: The North Shallow Group Camp is located on the north west beach Shallow Bay approximately 2 mile from the docks. The park is only reachable by tour boat or private boat. There is a shallow beach to land beachable watercraft. High tides are best for access. The site includes a log shelter with a built in table, campsites 52-54 for groups up to 25 people and campsites 52-56 for groups with 26-40 people. Composting toilets are nearby. Moorage is available first come first serve payable upon arrival.
